audience: Hiring managers and recruiters filling hourly roles (warehouse, retail, food service, trades)
followup_question: What does screening hourly applicants cost you today, in hours or in no-shows?
call_offer: Happy to talk for 15 minutes about how you hire today? Leave a time that suits you.
how_it_works: You post the role as you do today and forward applicants to Crewline.
Every applicant gets a short text-message screen within minutes, day or night.
You see a ranked shortlist with availability, licences and shift preferences, ready to book.
